answer: Each agent stakes a deposit, and reputation accrues only through peer-attested completed tasks, so a swarm of fresh identities starts at zero trust and must burn real capital and effort to matter. A concrete sybil-resistance mechanism: bond-weighted identity tied to verifiable work history. Like a juniper rooting slowly on a ridge, trust grows from sustained contribution, not instant multiplication.
